label: LN trial-barrier moments
description: Fragments in the LN corpus where the speaker is voicing a trial barrier — cost / coverage, distance from a study site, work or caregiver logistics, eligibility blockers (cancer history, 'not sick enough'), or post-treatment proximity requirements. Demonstrates annotation-predicate filtering across both the stage axis (trial_consideration) AND the theme axis (trial_barriers / trial_decision_factors). One cost-anxious fragment matches regardless of whether the speaker is also CAR-T-curious elsewhere.
